verdict.rationale: DeepInfra offers an OpenAI-compatible API and a zero-retention policy, meaning users are not locked into proprietary formats and their own request/response data isn't held hostage on DeepInfra's side, which supports easy migration/leaving. However, there is no explicit documentation of a data export feature, and probes for llms.txt/openapi/docs.md all 404, showing no dedicated export tooling. missing for 10: explicit data-export mechanism, evidence of exportable account/usage data, documented open-format export beyond API compatibility.
